dashboard.label: 10x Analytics Dashboard
dashboard.description: Monitor log optimization performance, storage savings, and ROI metrics

search.query: | tstats count where index=tenx_encoded | eval count=tostring(count, "commas")

index=tenx_encoded | head 5000 | eval encoded_size=len(_raw) | `tenx-inflate` | eval inflated_size=len(_raw) | stats avg(encoded_size) as avg_encoded, avg(inflated_size) as avg_inflated | eval ratio=round(avg_inflated/avg_encoded, 2) | eval ratio=ratio."x"

index=tenx_encoded | head 10000 | eval encoded_size=len(_raw) | `tenx-inflate` | eval inflated_size=len(_raw) | stats sum(encoded_size) as enc_bytes, sum(inflated_size) as inf_bytes | eval savings_mb=round((inf_bytes-enc_bytes)/1048576, 1) | eval savings_pct=round((1-(enc_bytes/inf_bytes))*100, 1) | eval display=savings_mb." MB (".savings_pct."%)" | table display

index=tenx_encoded | head 10000 | eval encoded_size=len(_raw) | `tenx-inflate` | eval inflated_size=len(_raw) | stats sum(encoded_size) as enc_bytes, sum(inflated_size) as inf_bytes | eval Encoded=round(enc_bytes/1048576, 2), Original=round(inf_bytes/1048576, 2) | eval Savings=Original-Encoded | fields Encoded, Original, Savings | untable _row metric MB
index=tenx_encoded | timechart span=1h count as "Encoded Events"

index=tenx_encoded | rex field=_raw "^~?(?<hash>[^,]+)" | stats count by hash | sort -count | head 10 | lookup tenx-dml-lookup _key as hash OUTPUT pattern | eval template=substr(pattern, 1, 50)."..." | table template, count

index=tenx_encoded | rex field=_raw "^~?(?<hash>[^,]+)" | stats count by hash | eval usage_bucket=case( count<10, "1-9 events", count<100, "10-99 events", count<1000, "100-999 events", count<10000, "1K-10K events", true(), "10K+ events" ) | stats count as templates by usage_bucket | sort usage_bucket

index=tenx_encoded | head 1000 | rex field=_raw "^~?(?<hash>[^,]+)" | `tenx-inflate` | eval success=if(match(_raw, "^~"), 0, 1) | stats sum(success) as successful, count as total | eval rate=round((successful/total)*100, 2)."%" | table rate
index=tenx_dml sourcetype=tenx_dml_raw_json | stats count as recent_templates | eval status=if(recent_templates>0, "Active", "Idle") | table status
index=_internal sourcetype=scheduler savedsearch_name="Consume KV" status=success | head 1 | eval last_run=strftime(_time, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | table last_run

index=tenx_encoded | head 5000 | eval encoded_size=len(_raw) | `tenx-inflate` | eval inflated_size=len(_raw) | stats avg(encoded_size) as avg_enc, avg(inflated_size) as avg_inf | eval reduction=round(avg_inf-avg_enc, 0)." bytes" | table reduction

index=tenx_encoded | rex field=_raw "^~?(?<hash>[^,]+)" | stats count as "Event Count" by hash | sort -"Event Count" | head 20 | lookup tenx-dml-lookup _key as hash OUTPUT pattern, timestamp_format | eval "Has Timestamp"=if(len(timestamp_format)>0, "Yes", "No") | eval "Pattern Preview"=substr(pattern, 1, 80) | rename hash as "Template Hash" | table "Template Hash", "Event Count", "Has Timestamp", "Pattern Preview"

index=tenx_encoded | head 10000 | eval encoded_size=len(_raw) | `tenx-inflate` | eval inflated_size=len(_raw) | stats sum(encoded_size) as enc_bytes, sum(inflated_size) as inf_bytes, count as sample_count | eval enc_mb=round(enc_bytes/1048576, 2) | eval inf_mb=round(inf_bytes/1048576, 2) | eval savings_mb=round(inf_mb-enc_mb, 2) | eval ratio=round(inf_bytes/enc_bytes, 2) | eval savings_pct=round((1-(enc_bytes/inf_bytes))*100, 1) | eval monthly_savings=round((savings_mb/1024)*15, 2) | rename sample_count as "Sample Events", inf_mb as "Original Size (MB)", enc_mb as "Encoded Size (MB)", savings_mb as "Storage Saved (MB)", ratio as "Compression Ratio", savings_pct as "Savings %", monthly_savings as "Monthly Savings ($)" | fields "Sample Events", "Original Size (MB)", "Encoded Size (MB)", "Storage Saved (MB)", "Compression Ratio", "Savings %", "Monthly Savings ($)"
